data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 银烛暗室里的血族威严
data.description: 四柱大床旁的幽暗寝室，多头银烛台静静燃烧。雾枝端坐在暗红天鹅绒高背扶手椅中，双手交叠于蕾丝裙裾之上，赤红双眸在跳跃的火苗中流转着至高威严。
data.location: opulent gothic private bedchamber beside heavy velvet curtains and tall candelabra
data.action: sitting tall in velvet wingback armchair, hands folded over black lace gown, gazing forward with calm hypnotic vampire authority
data.lighting: 西洋古堡暗室银质多头烛台明亮烛火与壁炉红光
data.promptProse: Kirie sits upright in a velvet wingback chair beside a candelabra, hands folded in her lap as her hypnotic crimson gaze holds the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Multiple flickering silver candelabras bathe Kirie in dramatic golden warmth as she sits regally upon the velvet chair.
